Name: gous

Items: 2–3 whole eggs cooked in ghee (pan fried or boiled)
1 bowl curd or a glass of buttermilk
1 small bowl rice with cooked vegetables (bottle gourd, ridge gourd, or spinach)
Small serving of fish or chicken (lightly cooked, not spicy)
150g grilled chicken, boiled fish, or paneer
1 small bowl rice or vegetable khichdi
Cooked vegetables such as beans, carrots, or snake gourd
Roasted makhana or puffed rice mixed with ghee and salt

NotesAndTips: Avoid sugar, sweets, bakery foods, and refined oils to support hormone balance.
Use ghee or butter for cooking instead of sunflower, groundnut, or seed oils.
Keep spice levels moderate to reduce cravings and improve digestion.
Include protein (eggs, chicken, fish, paneer) with every meal to control hunger and aid fat loss.
Take short walks or breathing breaks to manage stress and avoid overeating.
Avoid long gaps between meals; eat calmly and stop when satisfied.
Consistency will improve metabolism, reduce PCOS symptoms, and support lean body composition.
